At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> at least two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] personnel executed an [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] '''raid''', capturing several [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] at least one&mdash;[[Zherriak]]&mdash;in the process. However, the group of [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] Wookiees overpowered the Imperials who had taken them, commandeering their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] by force. Though most of the Wookiees opted to return to their home<ref name="DNH" />&mdash;the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]&mdash;in the [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] ship, the Wookiee [[Liak]] instead chose to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to fight the Empire and avenge his close friend Zherriak.<ref name="DNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid was mentioned in the short story "[[Do No Harm]]," which was written by [[Erin Endom]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|tenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="DNH" />
